name: Contractors Cloud
description:
Contractors Cloud is a CRM and business management platform for construction contractors. This connector links Claude to your Contractors Cloud account so you can work with your live business data in plain conversation.
  
Once connected, Claude can:
  • Search, create, and update contacts and customer accounts
  • Search projects, create projects with the correct setup options, and add project notes
  • Search, create, and update tasks
  • Find and run your reports, so Claude can answer questions from your live data
  • Search Contractors Cloud's official help documentation to answer "how do I…" questions about the product
  • Look up user details — your own or a teammate's

Claude acts as you: it signs in with your Contractors Cloud credentials and inherits your exact permissions and your company's data boundaries. It can only see and change what your own account can, and it can never access another company's data. Connecting is a one-time setup — sign in with your normal credentials and approve the connection. No API keys or developer setup required. Available to standard Contractors Cloud users.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Contractors Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Contractors Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.contractorscloud.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Contractors Cloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contractors Cloud lists 15 MCP tools, including account_search, account_write, contact_search, contact_write, help_article_get, help_article_search, project_create_options, project_note_write, project_search, project_write, report_run, and report_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Contractors Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Contractors Cloud in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Contractors Cloud MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contractors Cloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Contractors Cloud is developed by Contractors Cloud. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
